body.name: Mass-weighted global effect extension
body.construction: For \(u\in\mathbb R_+^4\), set \(\bar\mu_a(u)=u_{a1}/\max\{s_a(u),\epsilon s(u)\}\) when \(s(u)>0\) and \(0\) otherwise, set \(\bar\tau(u)=\bar\mu_1(u)-\bar\mu_0(u)\), and set \(F_f(u)=s(u)f(\bar\tau(u))\) for \(f\in\mathcal F_1\).
